overview.text: He wants to cut the gas tax and defend Proposition 13. In 2026, Politico reported he called the Palisades wildfire a “blessing for us” because it would reduce Democratic voters, drawing criticism. His campaign consultant said the remarks referred to previously Democratic voters who had their eyes opened by what he called the incompetence and mismanagement of Democratic leaders.
